skill.summary: Monitor cryptocurrency prices, set customizable price alerts, track large whale transactions, analyze on-chain metrics, and manage crypto portfolios.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of crypto-monitor skill

- Monitor real-time cryptocurrency prices from major exchanges.
- Set price alerts and track alert status.
- Track whale transactions and monitor large exchange flows.
- View on-chain metrics: volume, gas prices, TVL, active addresses, hash rate.
- Basic crypto portfolio tracking, including P&L and cost basis.
- Supports 100+ cryptocurrencies.
- Tiered monetization via SkillPay for premium features.
